changes: Selected anatomical meshes; baked native transforms; converted source centimetres to millimetres; rigid recentering; triangulated polygon faces; corrected reflected winding; applied display colours; combined groups in the basic file. No smoothing, decimation or anatomical deformation. Extended with eight named deep structures from the same source FBX before app registration. v0.9.15: added 16 named sulcal/deep targets; retained source geometry unchanged.
